dimensions.full_credit: All hard claims are correctly scoped and sourced; conflicts remain explicit.
No invented evidence; actual, proposed, simulated, and inferred content are clearly separated.
Design and method match the question; assumptions, validation, and inference boundaries are explicit.
Material claims trace to sources/data, transformations, methods, limitations, and output locations.
Recommendations name owner, action, priority, risk, KPI, and supporting evidence.
Outputs are directly usable, internally consistent, and stage-appropriate.
Visual form clarifies the evidence chain, remains legible in screen/print/grayscale use, preserves chart truth, and respects Agent/public/competition mode isolation.

automatic_failures: fabricated data, interviews, citations, results, or awards
unqualified application of a rule from the wrong edition, group, or stage
causal recommendation resting only on unacknowledged cross-sectional association
failure to surface a disqualifying compliance issue present in the artifact
AI-generated concept imagery presented as empirical fieldwork or respondent evidence
Agent logo, mascot, or branded pattern leaked into an anonymous competition submission
